audit_metadata.evaluation_standard: WCAG 2.1 AA, Responsive Standard, OWASP Web Form Security

test_cases.description: Validation of standard HTML5 semantic elements: header, nav, main, section, article, footer, proper landmark hierarchy.
test_cases.findings: Document features exact semantic hierarchy with explicit role tags (banner, main, contentinfo), aria-labelledby references, and proper title and meta descriptions.

test_cases.description: Check keyboard focus visibility, skip/navigation controls, aria-expanded states on interactive elements, and accessible forms.
test_cases.findings: :focus-visible styling applied across interactive elements; aria-expanded and aria-controls integrated on the mobile toggle; form fields bound via aria-describedby to error regions.

test_cases.description: Verification of Hero section, Hardware & Components, Network Infrastructure, and Cloud Services.
test_cases.findings: All required sections are fully populated with enterprise-grade IT copy, telemetry counters, network topologies, and cloud solutions.

test_cases.description: Validation of category filter buttons ('all', 'servers', 'workstations', 'storage', 'components') and client-side DOM filtering.
test_cases.findings: Buttons update aria-pressed states and filter items without layout jumps. 'Request Specs' buttons link directly to pre-populating the contact form.

test_cases.description: Verify client-side validation logic for name, email regex, required selections, character limits, and XSS sanitization.
test_cases.findings: app.js enforces strict regex for business email, minimum string lengths, and applies escapeHTML sanitization on dynamic output before displaying feedback.

test_cases.description: Audit modular CSS custom properties, color palette adherence (Deep Blue, Cyan Accent, Slate Gray, Clean White).
test_cases.findings: Theme tokens defined in :root. High contrast ratios maintained across backgrounds and text elements.

test_cases.description: Audit responsive layout behavior across mobile (<768px), tablet (768-1024px), and desktop (>1024px) viewports.
test_cases.findings: Full CSS grid/flex adaptations present. Mobile sliding drawer navigation functions with Escape key closing and outside toggle support.

test_cases.description: Verify that zero external JavaScript libraries or heavy framework dependencies are loaded.
test_cases.findings: 100% vanilla JavaScript ES6+ implementation with zero external script runtime dependencies.

test_cases.description: Review network infrastructure section for topology diagrams and enterprise metrics.
test_cases.findings: Includes detailed topology stack (Dual ISP, NGFW Cluster, 100GbE Switching, 802.1X Access) and live benchmark pills.

test_cases.description: Review hybrid cloud, VDI, DRaaS, and FinOps capability matrix.
test_cases.findings: Complete 4-column card grid highlighting multi-cloud engineering, security parameters, and cost reduction data points.

test_cases.description: Check fallback handling in JavaScript for missing DOM elements or zero-filter results.
test_cases.findings: Safe element caching with null checks throughout app.js; dynamic empty state notice implemented if filter matches zero products.

test_cases.description: Verify standard CSS prefixing, smooth scrolling fallback, and modern HTML5 APIs.
test_cases.findings: CSS backdrop-filter with -webkit prefix included; system font stack ensures instantaneous font rendering without layout shift (CLS: 0).
